grade5.title: Ratio as Fraction
grade5.explanation: Expressing ratios A:B in the functional fractional form of A/(A+B) or comparison fractions A/B.
examples: Express 3:4 as a fraction of the total: 3/(3+4) = 3/7.

grade5.title: Reverse Percentages
grade5.explanation: Finding original values before a percentage increase or decrease occurred.
examples: An item is £120 after a 20% increase. Original = 120 / 1.20 = £100.
